categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Modifies address handling in src/net.cpp for Tor and I2P privacy networks
categories.rationale: Prevents identity correlation between clearnet and privacy network peers caused by adversarial addrMe reporting. An adversary could supply an arbitrary routable address that the node then self-advertises paired with its listening port, potentially leaking custom clearnet ports across Tor/I2P networks.
